caption: The drawing depicts a lidded ceramic vessel with a round base, flaring sides, and a fitted lid, rendered in shades of reddish-brown and brown. The vessel has symmetrical handles on either side and stands on a short circular foot. The body and lid are adorned with geometric patterns, mainly repeating arches, lines, and triangular motifs. The lid features a knob at its center shaped like an acorn, with an oak leaf as part of its design, as highlighted in a separate oval inset detail at the upper right corner. Another inset at the lower left displays a close-up of one of the vessel’s handles, revealing a twisted, rope-like form. The background is plain and cream-colored, which emphasizes the color and details of the pottery form. The artist's name and the year, "Jessica Price 99," are inscribed in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Earthenware Bowl
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
